name: single insert and search
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('hello')
assert t.search('hello') == True

name: search missing word
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('hello')
assert t.search('world') == False

name: prefix matches longer word
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('hello')
assert t.starts_with('hel') == True

name: prefix of a shorter word that doesn't exist
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('hell')
assert t.search('hello') == False
assert t.starts_with('hell') == True

name: insert and search same word twice
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('apple')
t.insert('apple')
assert t.search('apple') == True

name: partial prefix that doesn't match any inserted word
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('hello')
assert t.starts_with('hey') == False

name: multiple words with common prefix
code:
t = Trie()
w = ['apple', 'app', 'application', 'apply']
for w_ in w:
    t.insert(w_)
assert t.search('apple') == True
assert t.search('app') == True
assert t.search('applic') == False
assert t.starts_with('app') == True

name: single character word
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('a')
assert t.search('a') == True
assert t.starts_with('a') == True

name: longest common prefix chain
code:
t = Trie()
w = ['a', 'ab', 'abc', 'abcd']
for w_ in w:
    t.insert(w_)
assert t.search('abcd') == True
assert t.starts_with('abc') == True
assert t.search('abcde') == False

name: overlapping words where one is suffix of another
code:
t = Trie()
t.insert('pineapple')
t.insert('ple')
assert t.search('pineapple') == True
assert t.search('ple') == True
assert t.starts_with('pin') == True
